title: Roast Chicken with Potatoes and Carrots
text: Heat the oven to 425F. Rub the chicken with oil, thyme, salt and pepper. Scatter potatoes, carrots and onion in a roasting pan, set the chicken on top and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes before carving.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Stew
text: Brown the chicken in a heavy pot, remove, and soften the onion and garlic. Return the chicken, add water, bay leaf, potatoes and carrots. Simmer gently for 45 minutes until the chicken is tender.

title: Potato and Carrot Soup
text: Melt the butter and soften the chopped onion. Add potatoes, carrots and water, then simmer 25 minutes. Blend until smooth and season to taste.

title: Garlic Roasted Potatoes
text: Toss cut potatoes with oil, garlic, rosemary and salt. Roast at 425F for 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.

title: Glazed Carrots
text: Simmer sliced carrots in a little water until nearly tender. Drain, add butter and honey, and cook until glossy. Finish with lemon juice.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
text: Cook onion, potatoes and carrots in stock until tender. Thicken with flour, stir in chicken and peas, pour into a crust, cover and bake at 400F for 35 minutes.

title: Lemon Garlic Chicken
text: Marinate chicken in lemon juice, garlic, oil and oregano for 30 minutes. Roast at 400F for 35 minutes until browned.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
text: Scramble the eggs and set aside. Stir-fry chicken, carrot and peas in hot oil. Add rice and soy sauce, fold in eggs and scallions and serve hot.

title: Beef and Potato Hash
text: Fry the potatoes in oil until browning. Add onion, carrot and beef and cook until the beef is done. Season well.

title: Classic Beef Stew
text: Dredge beef in flour and brown. Add onion, tomato paste, stock and bay leaf, then simmer for 1.5 hours. Add potatoes and carrots for the last 30 minutes.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
text: Cook pasta. Warm garlic in oil, add tomatoes and cook 10 minutes, then toss with pasta and torn basil.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
text: Cook pasta. Crisp the bacon. Beat eggs with parmesan and pepper, toss with hot pasta and bacon off the heat until creamy.

title: Mushroom Risotto
text: Soften onion and mushrooms in butter. Add rice, then stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes. Finish with parmesan.

title: Vegetable Frittata
text: Fry potato and onion in an oven-safe pan until soft. Pour over beaten eggs and cheese and bake at 375F for 15 minutes.

title: Pancakes
text: Whisk dry ingredients, add milk, egg and butter, and cook spoonfuls on a hot griddle until bubbles form, then flip.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
text: Soften onion and garlic in oil, add curry powder, tomatoes and chickpeas, simmer 15 minutes, and wilt in the spinach.

title: Lentil Soup
text: Soften the vegetables, add lentils, tomatoes, cumin and water, and simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon
text: Place salmon on a tray, drizzle with oil and lemon, sprinkle with dill, and bake at 400F for 12 minutes.

title: Shepherd's Pie
text: Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk. Brown lamb with onion and carrots, stir in flour and peas, top with the mash, and bake at 400F for 25 minutes.

title: Beef Tacos
text: Brown the beef with seasoning. Fill shells with beef, tomato, lettuce and cheese.

title: Egg Salad Sandwich
text: Chop the eggs, mix with mayonnaise and mustard, season, and spread on bread.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
text: Hollow the peppers. Mix browned beef, rice, onion and tomatoes, fill the peppers, top with cheese, and bake at 375F for 35 minutes.

title: Banana Bread
text: Mash bananas, mix in butter, sugar and egg, fold in flour and soda, and bake in a loaf pan at 350F for 60 minutes.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
text: Simmer chicken with vegetables in stock for 20 minutes, shred the chicken, add noodles, and cook 8 minutes.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken and Carrots
text: Whisk honey and mustard, coat chicken and carrots on a sheet pan, and roast at 425F for 35 minutes.
